questions.stem_text:
Suppose that the federal government reclassified the purchase of a new home as consumption
spending rather than investment spending. This decision would

options.A: increase aggregate demand and decrease real GDP.
options.B: decrease aggregate demand and decrease real GDP.
options.C: decrease aggregate demand and increase real GDP.
options.D: have no impact on aggregate demand and real GDP.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - have no impact on aggregate demand and real GDP.

questions.stem_text: All else equal when the United States exports more goods and services

options.A: the value of the dollar falls as the supply of dollars increases.
options.B: the value of the dollar rises as demand for dollars increases.
options.C: the value of the dollar falls as demand for dollars decreases.
options.D: the value of the dollar rises as the supply of dollars increases.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - the value of the dollar rises as demand for dollars increases.

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following is an implicit cost for the owner of a small store in your
hometown?

options.A: The wage that is paid to the assistant manager
options.B: The cost of purchasing canned goods from a wholesale food distributor
options.C: The value placed on the owner's skills in an alternative career
options.D: The cost of cooling the refrigerated meat display

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - The value placed on the owner's skills in an alternative career

questions.stem_text: Unlike a perfectly competitive firm, a monopoly

options.A: will charge the highest price it can on the demand curve
options.B: has a horizontal marginal revenue curve
options.C: has an upward sloping total revenue curve
options.D: faces a downward sloping demand curve

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - faces a downward sloping demand curve
